scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @niko/landing && npm run build -w @niko/app && npm run build -w @niko/admin
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @niko/api && tsc --noEmit -p apps/app/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/admin/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npm run deploy -w @niko/api
